segments.text:
Never let Believers fear the want of any good thing necessary
for them in this world: the favour of God is the fountain of all blessings, provisions, protections, even of all that you need. He hath promised that he will withhold no good thing from
them that walk uprightly, Psal. 84. 11. He that is bountiful to his enemies will not withhold what is good from his friends. The favour of God will not only supply your needs, but protect your persons, Psal. 5. 12. Thou wilt bless the righteous, with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.
